Embedding request with multiple inputs returns multiple embedding objects

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.embed(LiterLlm::EmbeddingRequest.new(input: ['Hello world', 'Goodbye world'], model: 'text-embedding-3-small'))
puts result.inspect
```
